description: Marble Meats — saturated, serif-led food commerce derived from reference R02 (Beefy). Reproduces the Mission 017 design decisions exactly; every constant that used to be baked into the token compiler now lives here.

typography.displayRoleNote: High-contrast serif for display, product names and section anchors. The reference's own type is a high-contrast serif at display sizes; identity of the face is NOT inferred, only the role.

responsive.mobile: Single column. Product grid 2-up. Fixed bottom tab bar (Home / Bag). Hero field full-bleed with the content sheet overlapping it.
responsive.desktop: Product grid 4-up. Tab bar hidden; bag action moves inline into the hero brand row. Sheet and detail sheet drop the bottom padding reserved for the tab bar.
